identity_reason: it is Table for its pane, header and rows and Checkbox for its marks, so only choosing and cell focus are new
concept: Table as an interactive grid with one tab stop, arrow keys between cells and chosen glass with a check on chosen rows.

root.why: the grid is Table pane and holds the loading cover over its rows

check.why: the checkbox column is a 44px press area wide so every row can be chosen by touch

cell.why: the cell the keyboard is in shows the focus ring inside its edges

chosen.why: a chosen row takes chosen glass as well as its checked box

stick.why: the name column stays in view on the opaque sheet tone while the grid scrolls sideways

loading.why: while rows load the old rows stay under a scrim so the reader keeps their place

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable

focus-visible.why: the focused cell shows the ring when reached by the arrow keys

hover.why: a chosen row keeps its chosen glass under the pointer
